title: Raw abelian presheaf colimit evaluation at a carried object
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of abelian groups. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be an abelian presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every abelian presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C,\mathrm{Ab})$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$.Assume the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $U\in F(i)$ and an abelian group diagram $D:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ with isomorphisms $E_t:D(t)\cong A_t(F(t.hom)U)$. Suppose $E_t\theta_b= D(b)E_{t'}$ as arrow objects. Let $T$ be any abelian presheaf on $C$, $\gamma:B\to\mathrm{const}(T)$ natural, and $a_t:A_t\to V_t^pT$ with $\beta_t(X)\gamma_t(V_tX)=a_t(X)$. There exist a colimit cocone $R$ of $D$ and an isomorphism $q:R.pt\cong(\mathrm{colim}\,B)(V_iU)$ such that $R_tq(\mathrm{colim.desc}\,\gamma)(V_iU)=E_t a_t(F(t.hom)U)$ as arrow objects for each $t$. Neither $T$ nor $\mathrm{colim}\,B$ is assumed to be a sheaf.

proof.text: Set R to the chosen abelian colimit cocone of D. Construct kappa_t by E_t, beta_t, the colimit B coprojection, and the cocone endpoint transport. The equations hm and hbeta_map and colimit.w make these maps a cocone K. Let mu = colimit.desc D K; colimit.ι_desc gives its coprojection equation.

Apply raw abelian section generators to kappa and its proved cocone naturality. Every target element has a stage representative, so the coprojection formula for mu makes it surjective. Apply raw abelian section relations to two representatives with equal mu images. Their D images agree after refinement; naturality of the D coprojections makes their colimit classes equal. Because the abelian forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits, every element of colimit D has a representative, hence mu is injective.

ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective turns the two proved properties into IsIso mu. Set q = asIso mu. Compose the coprojection equation with colimit.desc B gamma. Naturality moves the endpoint transport to T; colimit.ι_desc_app replaces the B coprojection by gamma_t. Apply ha, then Arrow.arrow_mk_comp_eqToHom, to obtain the unchanged Arrow equality.

theorem colimit_site_raw_abelian_section_evaluation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (T : V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (γ : B ⟶ (Functor.const (Under i)).obj T)
    (a : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ T)
    (ha : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj t.right),
      (β t).app (op X) ≫
        (γ.app t).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X)) = (a t).app (op X))
    (hm : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) :
    ∃ (R : Cocone D)
      (q : R.pt ≅ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))),
      Nonempty (IsColimit R) ∧
      ∀ t : Under i,
        Arrow.mk (R.ι.app t ≫ q.hom ≫
          (colimit.desc B (Cocone.mk T γ)).app
            (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))) =
        Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (a t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
